name: Base Game Modern House 1
author: SimsWithNora
style: Two-storey modern: a dark-timber flat-roofed box under a floating two-band lid, white and striped piers, a French entry on a tiled porch and a glazed bay with slat fins, stands forward of a white double-gable wing whose front gable is an open frame; gravel forecourt, a timber deck wrapped by a reflecting rill, a koi fountain by the drive
